allOf.description: List of properties of the element template.

property.description: The id of the property to check.

isActive.description: For `true`, activates the property when given property is active

allOf.$comment: property#condition should not depend on property#id

value.description: The value of a control field.

description.description: The description of a control field.

label.description: The label of a control field.

type.description: The type of a control field.

editable.description: Indicates whether a control field is editable or not.

constraints.description: The validation constraints of a control field.

notEmpty.description: The control field must not be empty.

minLength.description: The minimal length of a control field value.

maxLength.description: The maximal length for a control field value.

pattern.description: A regular expression pattern for a constraint.

value.description: The regular expression of a pattern.

message.description: The validation message of a pattern.

group.description: The custom group of a control field.

allOf.description: List of properties of the element template.

allOf.$comment: AdHoc output properties require string-based types (Hidden, String, Text, or Dropdown)
outputCollection properties must not be FEEL expressions

value.description: The value must be conforming to an ISO 8601 combined date and time representation.

binding.description: Specifying how the property is mapped to BPMN or Zeebe extension elements and attributes.

type.description: The type of a property binding.

name.description: The name of a property binding.

source.description: The source value of a property binding (zeebe:output).

key.description: The key value of a property binding (zeebe:taskHeader).

property.description: The name of the property defined in the binding.

optional.description: Indicates whether a property is optional. Optional bindings do not persist empty values in the underlying BPMN 2.0 XML.

feel.description: Indicates whether the property can be a feel expression

language.description: Indicates that the field is a custom language editor

generatedValue.description: Sets property to a generated value according to given scheme.

name.description: The name of the element template.

id.description: The identifier of the element template.

description.description: The description of the element template.

version.description: Optional version of the template. If you add a version to a template it will be considered unique based on its ID and version. Two templates can have the same ID if their version is different.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether the element template is a default template.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether the element template is deprecated.

message.description: Optional message to describe migration path.

appliesTo.description: List of BPMN types the template can be applied to.

elementType.description: The BPMN type the element will be transformed into.

metadata.description: Some custom properties for further configuration.

keywords.description: List of keywords to describe the element template.

entriesVisible.description: Select whether non-template entries are visible in the properties panel.

groups.description: Custom fields can be ordered together via groups.

id.description: The id of the custom group

label.description: The label of the custom group

allOf.$comment: When zeebe:adHoc output properties are used, all three required bindings must be present together
When zeebe:taskDefinition is used, bpmn:cancelRemainingInstances, bpmn:completionCondition, and zeebe:activeElementsCollection properties are not allowed

engines.description: Defines the compatibility of this element template with different engines. Keys are engine names, values are semantic version ranges.

camunda.description: A semantic version range that denotes compatible Camunda versions.

category.description: A custom category to semantically group element templates

id.description: The unique identifier of the category.

icon.description: Custom icon to be shown on the element

openByDefault.description: Specifies whether the Group should be opened when first viewed. Defaults to false.

oneOf.description: A list of element template configurations.
